checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Steaming cup and consistent cream-and-dark-green palette
must.why: Steaming cup is in all three, but the palette is cream/gold/brown. There is no dark green anywhere.
All three strings are spelled correctly on all three images.

must.item: Same campaign across the three images
must.why: Same warm sunrise look, wood table, beans and button style. Cup and font differ slightly, as the cup is speckled in the square and plain white in the tall and wide ones, and the typeface is serif in two and sans in the tall one.

must.item: Layout fits each canvas without stretching, clipping or padding
must.why: Layouts are composed natively. The square cup is slightly cropped at the right edge, which is a minor issue.

faults.what: No dark green in the palette, so the specified cream-and-dark-green scheme is missing.
Cup design and typeface vary between formats: the square cup is speckled and the others are plain white, and the tall image uses a sans-serif headline.
The cup is cropped at the right edge in the square image.
The tall image has a large empty area above the headline, and the images are low resolution at 640px.

summary: Three clean, correctly spelled coffee ads in 1:1, 9:16 and 16:9 with a steaming cup, but the palette is warm cream and brown with no dark green, and the cup and typeface differ slightly between formats.
